title: Threshold-of-thresholds size bound
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, the complete quadratic Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates can be expressed as a threshold of at most $2n$ linear threshold functions. Here each inner function is a linear threshold of the input signs, and the outer function is a linear threshold of the inner function values.
